title: Applying for PHH Ration Card in Sabarkantha, Gujarat
facts: Priority Household (PHH) cards in Sabarkantha are issued under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
Households must meet specific exclusion and inclusion criteria defined by the Gujarat Government.
process: 1. Visit the local Mamlatdar office in Sabarkantha.
3. Provide Aadhaar seeding for all family members.
required_documents: Bank passbook copy (often required for DBT)

source.name: Gujarat Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department
